_about: Hand-written shop content for AirPay, keyed by Bitrefill product id. Merge each entry into that product's JSON in duffleserver/shop.py -> _trim. Key names are the ones Shop.kt -> guide() already reads; tab_label and tab_line are new. Written 2026-10-02 from Bitrefill's descriptions, instructions and terms as they stood on 2026-10-01. Not legal text. A missing key means the catalogue does not say.

hotstar-india.valid_for: Has an expiry date, shown with the code
hotstar-india.how_used: One use. Unused value is lost
know: Works in India only.
Not refunded once the code is delivered.
steps: Go to hotstar.com/redeem.
Log in with your phone number.
Enter the code and press Apply.
Open the Hotstar app with the same number.
hotstar-india.amounts: Each amount is the price of a Hotstar plan. The catalogue does not say which plan each one is, so check hotstar.com first.

phonepe-india.line: Pay bills, recharge phones, order food and more.
phonepe-india.valid_for: Has a validity period, shown with the code
phonepe-india.how_used: Use it more than once, until the balance runs out
know: Cannot be cancelled or refunded once bought.
If the PIN has 5 digits, add a 0 in front of it.
steps: Open PhonePe's gift card page.
Enter the code you were sent.
Pick what to spend it on.
Finish the payment.
phonepe-india.amounts: The amount is the balance on the card, in rupees.

steps: Book on makemytrip.com or in the MakeMyTrip app, up to the payment page.
Choose Gift Card as the way to pay.
Enter the 16-digit card number and the 6-digit PIN.
Pay anything left over another way.
makemytrip-voucher-india.amounts: The amount is the balance on the card, in rupees.

google-play-india.line: Apps, games, subscriptions and YouTube Premium.
google-play-india.where_it_works: Google Play, on Android and on the web
google-play-india.how_used: Redeemed once. The whole amount goes to your Google balance
know: Your Google account and location must be set to India.
Google may ask for extra details the first time you redeem.
steps: Open the Google Play app.
Tap your profile picture.
Tap Payments & subscriptions, then Redeem code.
Enter the code.
google-play-india.amounts: The amount is added to your Google Play balance. Spend it on apps, games, subscriptions or YouTube Premium.

Tap your profile, then Promo Code.
Enter the code and press Submit.
tinder-plus-and-gold-india.amounts: Each price is one subscription code. The catalogue does not say which plan each price unlocks.
